incidents.name: UPENG arbitrary-address burn plus permissionless sync
incidents.notes: UPENG exposes burn(address,uint256) to any caller, so the attacker destroyed the Pancake pair's UPENG balance, synced the pair down to one wei and sold its own UPENG into the 1.5 WBNB reserve.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0x4303cdDBeF06B5820F10DbC00206f8Bde6749E2F created 2025-07-13T10:59:27Z by 0x5b1a6bd46852d298e0cfbbe556f8bb646995545e, which is not the attack-tx sender 0x37023a0c3440106cf50dc8498dcd64fdbb1e837a; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain). 1.5 WBNB x $690.12/BNB at the incident timestamp 1752406129 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $1,035.
